verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing's API supports core card-program actions an agent would need—creating cards, activating/suspending/closing them, updating balance account linkage, and defining transaction rules for spend control (docs-1, docs-3, docs-10, docs-11)—but there is no mention of an MCP surface, no explicit scoped API-credential/permission model, and no clear API endpoint documentation for reading balances/transaction history (only a Customer Area UI view is cited, docs-13). missing for 10: MCP server/tool surface, scoped API-key/credential scoping documentation, explicit balance/transaction-read API endpoints.
